name: Detroit Woodworking
old_description: Detroit Woodworking specializes in custom residential woodworking, collaborating with homeowners, architects, and designers to create handcrafted cabinetry, intricate moldings, and custom furniture with exceptional attention to detail. Serving Grosse Pointe and Metro Detroit, we blend traditional and modern design using premium materials to craft durable, inviting spaces while ensuring a seamless experience from consultation to installation.
about:
Detroit Woodworking operates a design-build custom millwork shop in Roseville, Michigan. The family-owned business serves metro Detroit and ships nationwide, drawing on decades of experience in millwork and cabinetry.

The company produces custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, custom doors, live-edge furniture, conference tables, healthcare and educational casework, and specialty fabrication including prototype and one-off pieces. Its production facility combines CNC machining, laser engraving, and professional finishing systems with traditional craftsmanship. The shop handles projects from design engineering through installation, using AutoCAD drawings and 3D renderings to develop each job.

Clients include homeowners, architects, designers, developers, and corporations across residential construction, hospitality, restaurants, retail, healthcare, education, multi-family, and corporate environments. The firm has delivered custom cabinetry, fixtures, and displays for local businesses and large-scale replicable millwork programs.

Detroit Woodworking emphasizes a seamless experience from consultation to installation, offering dedicated project management, white-glove delivery, climate-controlled storage, and a limited lifetime warranty on all custom cabinetry and millwork. The shop notes it is one of the few in the Detroit area with a state-of-the-art laser engraving machine for intricate detailing.
